scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 10 boards of one live Deity Russia Religious-target game (civvis-20261109T173049Z), the first full game recorded with a Guru's heal charges, each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where our Guru had moves and heals left, a wounded unit of its faith stood at least two tiles away, and a rival religious unit was known. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with guru-walks-to-the-wounded. The Guru's orders differ on 5 of 10 boards; on 2 of them the on arm reaches a wounded friend and heals that turn where the off arm only walks.
